intro: Browse HTTP, HTTPS, IPFS and IPNS. IPFS content is fetched by your built-in Kubo node.
importWarning: Folders include hidden files. Selected content is not encrypted and will be pinned locally. People who know its CID can retrieve it while your node is running.
sharedWarning: All IPFS/IPNS pages share site data. Do not store secrets there. Relative paths and explicit /ipfs/CID/… paths are supported.
nodeUnavailable: Node unavailable. Check its status above.
importBusy: Select content. Adding and pinning may take a while…
importSaveFailed: Added and pinned. Local save failed: {error}
importSuccess: Added and pinned: {names}. Address saved to bookmarks.
catalogNote: Community archives and demos. Descriptions were supplied with this collection; availability and compatibility depend on peers and the original content. Opening a link does not pin it.
nodeNotReady: The IPFS node is not ready
importRunning: An IPFS import is already in progress
forbiddenNavigation: Navigation to this address is not allowed
invalidProtocol: Unsupported protocol or credentials in URL
noPeers: No peers connected. Cached content may still be available.
duplicateNames: Selected files have duplicate names. Add them separately or choose their common folder.
fileChanged: The selected file changed its type
importIncomplete: Kubo did not confirm a complete import
missingRoot: Kubo response is missing the final folder
siteScope: Zoom and audio preferences apply to this website; for IPFS/IPNS they apply to this content root.
pinRoot: Pin protects the entire CID root, including files in its directory.
permissionsDenied: Sensitive permissions are blocked in this version.
pageChanged: The page changed. Reopen its settings.
aboutBrowser: A Linux browser for the web and IPFS, with a built-in Kubo node. Your history and bookmarks stay on this device.
statusManifest: Collection note: cryptographic IPNS from a Distributed Press manifest (repository version); may point to an older snapshot.
statusReference: Collection note: address listed in project documentation or a repository; availability unconfirmed.
statusIndex: Collection note: IPNS/DNSLink listed in the Distributed Press index supplied with this collection; reachability unconfirmed.
statusPrevious: From the earlier collection; availability unconfirmed.
folderDeleteNote: Deleting a folder moves its bookmarks to the bookmarks bar.
clearDataDetail: History, cookies, site storage and cache will be deleted. Bookmarks, pins and IPFS content are kept.
nodeStarting: The IPFS node is already starting
